name: Mining Target
description: Mine words to your JPDB decks for spaced repetition review. Requires your own JPDB API key and a deck ID. You are responsible for complying with JPDB's terms of service.

apiKey.label: JPDB API key
apiKey.description: Get your API key from jpdb.io/settings (Account tab).

deckId.label: Default deck ID
deckId.description: The deck ID to mine words into. Find it in your JPDB deck URL (the number after /deck/).
